description: This file manages dynamic interactions for a web page, including modal dialogs for editing and adding table columns, and handling print events to preserve button states.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Opens the modal to edit a table column, setting the current column's name in the input field.

methods.name: addCol
methods.description: Adds a new column to the table with a button that triggers editing, and appends empty cells to each row.

methods.name: saveCol
methods.description: Saves the edited column name and updates the table header.

methods.name: deleteCol
methods.description: Removes the selected column from the table and its associated cells.
